An Intelligent Integrated Student 
Support & Management System

Presented By
Ishan Rajwani (S23CSC031)
Carol Swan (S23CSC006)
M. Hassan Siddiqui (S22CSC003)

Supervisors:
Supervisors: Sir Ateeque
Co-Supervisor: Miss Saadia Karim

Many universities still rely on multiple disconnected systems to manage academic and administrative activities. Students often use different portals for complaints, notifications, internships, academic planning, and communication, making the overall experience inefficient.

Academic Planning
Student Dashboard
Complaint Management
Notification System
Forms Center
Internship Module
Mentorship Module
AI Assistant (Planned for FYP-II)
GPU Allocation
UniSphere is a centralized web-based platform that brings together multiple student support services into one intelligent system.

Problem Statement

Current university systems suffer from:
Fragmented platforms
Lack of centralized student support
Manual complaint handling
Poor communication
No intelligent academic assistance
Scattered internship opportunities
No structured mentorship
These issues reduce student productivity and create administrative challenges.

Research Gap
No existing solution combines academic planning, complaints, mentorship, internships, notifications, and AI assistance into a single university-focused platform.
